99408d45-9e12-4f24-af2d-54c9c607796c.title: Vietnamese Rice Paper Salad (Banh Trang Tron)
99408d45-9e12-4f24-af2d-54c9c607796c.instructions: 1. Place rice paper strips in a large mixing bowl. 2. Add shredded green mango, beef jerky, dried shrimp, and quail eggs. 3. Squeeze kumquat juice over the mixture and sprinkle with chili shrimp salt. 4. Add scallion oil and mix well until the rice paper softens slightly but remains chewy. 5. Top with roasted peanuts, fried shallots, and Vietnamese coriander. Serve immediately.
